body:
Reported by the owner on 2026-10-04 from a controller session on the bench.

## Finding

On the Arty board, the controller's mapping view shows no connection between the stream ports and their audio clusters: no stream-port channel is routed to a cluster channel.

For contrast, the AX7101 DUT at the same time (read over ATDECC on 2026-10-04 14:30) reported one dynamic mapping on STREAM_PORT_INPUT 0 (stream ch 0 to cluster 0 ch 0) and an empty STREAM_PORT_OUTPUT 0 map. Earlier bench lanes routed audio through AX7101 mappings added over ATDECC (ADD_AUDIO_MAPPINGS), so the AX7101 path works when mappings exist.

## To establish

1. On the Arty image in use, read the STREAM_PORT_INPUT/OUTPUT descriptors (number_of_clusters / base_cluster, number_of_maps), GET_AUDIO_MAP, and whether ADD_AUDIO_MAPPINGS is accepted and read back. This decides whether the cause is an empty default map, a refused add, or a port-to-cluster linkage error in the AEM.
2. Compare with the AX7101's descriptor walk.
3. Record the Arty image's build.

The Arty is future work under #583 (milestone "Multiple boards support"). This ticket records the observation for when that work resumes, unless the same is found on the AX7101.
title: AX7101 (and Arty): no usable default audio map; Stream In 0 holds 1 of 4 mappings, Stream Out 0 none (owner report)
